questions.question: What is cloud computing according to the AWS whitepaper?
questions.reference_answer: Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of compute power, database, storage, applications, and other IT resources through a cloud services platform via the internet with pay-as-you-go pricing. It provides rapid access to flexible and low-cost IT resources without large upfront hardware investments.

questions.question: What are AWS Regions and Availability Zones?
questions.reference_answer: The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around AWS Regions and Availability Zones. An AWS Region is a physical location that contains multiple Availability Zones. Availability Zones consist of one or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and connectivity in separate facilities, enabling highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable applications and databases.

questions.question: What is the difference between Amazon SQS Standard queues and FIFO queues?
questions.reference_answer: Amazon SQS offers Standard queues and FIFO queues. Standard queues offer maximum throughput, best-effort ordering, and at-least-once delivery. FIFO queues guarantee that messages are processed exactly once, in the exact order they are sent.
